items.abstract: <jats:p>The study elucidates the gravitationally induced quantum decoherence via the Bohmian trajectories of the relativistic Quarkonium oscillator in conic gravitational space-time and its time-dependent thermodynamic properties through the quantum phase transitions. First, the Klein-Gordon (KG) equation is solved with respect to the constrained metric, and the quantum behavior is discussed with respect to the complex energy eigen-values. Secondly, the Bohmian trajectories are investigated with respect to the quantum Hamilton Jacobi equation (QHJE) in de Broglie-Bohm (dBB) perspective to investigate the interaction of the Quarkonium oscillator with the space-time background by the resonance regimes and the phase of the complex quantum trajectories. Finally, the thermodynamic evolution of the system with respect to time is discussed through the complex partition function and the quantum phase transitions are examined.</jats:p>
title: Gravitational Decoherence Through the Bohmian Trajectories and Complex Thermodynamics of the Relativistic Quarkonium Oscillator
